title: 2008 Upper Deck First Edition - #393 Ryan Braun Brewers Milwaukee Brewers
categoryName: Sports Mem, Cards & Fan Shop:Sports Trading Cards:Trading Card Singles
descriptionText:
This 2008 Upper Deck First Edition sports trading card features Ryan Braun, the Major League Baseball player from the Milwaukee Brewers team. The card is a part of the base set and has the card number 393. It is a standard-sized card and was manufactured in the United States by Upper Deck. 

This trading card is a great addition to any baseball fan's collection. It is perfect for those who admire Ryan Braun's skills and want to own a piece of baseball history. The card is not autographed, but it still has value. So, don't miss out on the chance to own this 2008 Upper Deck First Edition Ryan Braun trading card.
